answer:
Your Porto weekend note now has an App side, and `check_app` found no issues. I haven't pressed the reminder button on a real device, so that part is untested.

- **Reminder button:** it reads the flight date from the "flights:" line in your note, so it will follow any change to that line. It sets a phone reminder for the evening before the flight, 15 Oct at 19:00. After you press it, the app shows that the reminder is set. I chose 19:00 myself, since you didn't give a time.
- **What else is on it:** a countdown to the trip, the flight and hotel details with the budget, your ideas list, and the to-do checklist with tick boxes. Ticking a box there updates the note itself.

  "guide": "# Building apps in Amber Notes notes

A note can have an app: one HTML document shown on the note's App side, next to its Text side. A habit grid, a budget with totals, flashcards, a trip planner. In the tools it's called the note's page (set_note_page, get_note_page); when you talk to the person, call it "the note's app" or "the App side", and never "page" or "Pages".
